name: CSW Industrials, Inc.
summary: CSW Industrials, Inc. provides various industrial products in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and the Asia Pacific regions. The Contractor Solutions segment offers condensate pads, pans, and pumps; condensate switches and traps; drain management system; drain waste and vent systems mechanical products; ductless mini-split systems installation support tools and accessories; HVAC electrical protection, installation supplies, and maintenance chemicals; evaporator coils and air handlers; grilles, registers, and diffusers and vents; line set covers; load management systems; motors and capacitors; refrigerant caps; solvents, cements, traps, and thread sealants; surge protections;…
